problems.title: Fix Off-by-One Loop Sum
problems.description: The function calculateTotal should return the sum of all elements in the items array (10 + 25 + 45 + 5 = 85). Fix the loop index bug so it starts from the first element.

problems.title: Fix Word Reversal Slicing
problems.description: The function reverse_words should reverse the order of words in a sentence. Currently it skips words with an incorrect step size. Fix it so it prints 'fox brown quick the'.

problems.title: Fix Float Average Division
problems.description: Calculate the average of 3 test scores (85, 90, 88). Currently integer division truncates the result to 87.00. Fix the division to produce the exact average 87.67.

problems.title: Fix Negative Numbers Maximum
problems.description: Find the maximum number in an array of negative integers. Fix the initial value bug that causes it to incorrectly print 0 instead of -3.

problems.title: Fix Java String Equality
problems.description: In Java, checking string equality with '==' compares memory addresses rather than string content. Fix the comparison so it correctly prints 'ACCESS GRANTED'.

problems.title: Fix Factorial Zero Bug
problems.description: The factorial of 5 is 5 * 4 * 3 * 2 * 1 = 120. Currently the loop multiplies down to 0, resulting in 0. Fix the loop boundary.
